project_type: Python FastAPI backend - Autonomous AI Company OS
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio (auto mode), mock db sessions from conftest.py
verification_instructions: 1. Run pytest to confirm all tests pass (baseline: 749 tests). 2. Confirm no import errors with python -c 'import nexus'
snapshot_or_generated_files: alembic/versions/ contains migration files generated by alembic revision --autogenerate
environment_constraints: Python 3.9 is system default; must use /root/.pyenv/versions/3.12.13/bin/python explicitly. No PostgreSQL or Redis running. Tests use mock db sessions (AsyncMock). Alembic migration generation requires DB connection (may need offline mode or mock).
contribution_requirements: All code must have docstrings, type hints, ruff-compatible (100 char line length), Python 3.12 features (type unions with |). Every module independently testable. Do NOT touch dashboard/frontend.
key_patterns: 1. Pure logic classes with optional db param (see observer.py, heartbeat.py). 2. SQLModel for DB models in src/nexus/models/. 3. Protocols for dependency injection (see company_flow.py EventBusProtocol). 4. Tests use fixtures from conftest.py (mock_db_session, sample_*_id). 5. @dataclass for value objects. 6. Enum for state machines. 7. async methods for DB operations, sync for pure logic.
directory_structure: src/nexus/ - main package: adapters/, api/, communication/, company/, config.py, database.py, demo/, evolution/, governance/, guardrails/, identity/, knowledge/, main.py, meetings/, memory/, models/, models_router/, orchestration/, runtime/, services/, templates/, tools/, triggers/, workflows/. tests/ - flat test files. alembic/ - migrations.
